summary: Frontend-only test of the new manual Twilio dialer in the vendor Inbox. Verified all six required behaviors: (1) New call button opens the dialer modal, (2) Call button is gated on E.164 validity (disabled for '+' alone and for '12345'), (3) Number can be entered via input field and via the 12-key dialpad; backspace works; (4) With a valid number (+447700900123) + optional name (Test Lead), clicking Call closes the modal, opens the CallWidget in the TOP-RIGHT (bbox x=1576 y=24 in 1920x900), and creates a new voice thread in the Inbox that contains the '📞 Outgoing call to +447700900123' message, (5) CallWidget ends in the expected 'Couldn’t connect / Voice is not fully set up for this account yet.' error state with data-testid=call-error and call-done-btn (EXPECTED PASS per spec, no real Twilio subaccount), (6) Modal dismisses via both the X (dialer-close) and the overlay click. Mobile viewport (390x844): New call button visible in threads header, dialer modal opens and dialpad keys render correctly.

issues: React hydration console warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option> in the m-channel-filter <select>. Likely coming from injected instrumentation attributes (x-dynamic spans) but worth ensuring options render only plain text.

critical_code_review_comments: Dialer.press() has a subtle no-op for the '+' key: `n === '+' ? '+' : n) + k` means typing anything after '+' works fine, but if a user clears back to '+' and taps '*' or '#' the resulting '+*'/ '+#' will fail E.164 regex silently (button stays disabled). Consider disallowing '*'/'#' when the buffer is just '+' or providing inline feedback.

Dialer overlay click closes the modal on any click that isn’t within the inner card (stopPropagation on modal). This is fine, but consider preventing close while a call POST is in-flight (loading=true) to avoid interrupting the request.
Inbox `toCallable` builds '+' + digits regardless of the leading char check — the two branches produce the same string; the ternary is dead code. Minor cleanup.
seed_data_creation: Created one voice conversation via the flow: '+447700900123' / 'Test Lead' with an 'Outgoing call to +447700900123' seed message.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dialer flow is fully wired: Inbox 'New call' -> Dialer -> POST /api/voice/browser/dial-prepare -> onStart sets callTarget (provider=twilio), reloads threads, opens CallWidget top-right. On this exempt test account the CallWidget expectedly ends in 'Couldn’t connect (Voice not fully set up)' — that is by design and should not be flagged. If retesting, note that each successful Call creates a persistent voice thread; the backend reuses it on repeat dials to the same number.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects found in the dialer UI flow.
